title: Where Form Remembers It Was Never Fixed

features.name: the-remembering-chip
features.desc-on-touch: a circuit trace that flows backward into itself—the board remembers being a sketch; the sketch remembers being a thought that hadn't decided its own angle yet

features.name: the-wireframe-echo
features.desc-on-touch: a half-rendered corner of something larger—every time you look it has rotated just slightly, or maybe you have, and there's no way to tell which one moved

features.name: the-trace-that-learned-sideways
features.desc-on-touch: a trace that spirals up and left at once, defying the board's grid; beneath it, you can see an older trace that ran straight, but this one taught it to dream

features.name: the-geometry-that-refuses
features.desc-on-touch: in this corner, angles that should sum to 360° only reach 297; the archive recorded this and called it stable—the board teaches that truth can be incomplete

inscription: in the board's dream, the circuit learns that direction is something geometry votes on, not something space decides alone

file.name: Geometry_Studies_Sideways_Sketches.txt
file.note: field notes on shapes that changed their minds, angles that learned to question, a draft for a theorem that never solidified
